source_records.title: All Souls bread almsgiving
source_records.geographic_scope: Poland only in independently corroborated evidence; not a French practice certificate
source_records.source_basis: Published Polish Ethnographic Atlas research from 1969–1977 surveys
source_records.scope_verified: Bread and baked goods given to poorer people outside churches or at cemeteries on All Souls' Day in surveyed Polish communities; historical charity, not a universal rule.

corroboration.issuer: Cyfrowe Archiwum Polskiego Atlasu Etnograficznego — map 43
corroboration.contribution: Published field-survey map specifically documenting All Souls bread alms to poor people, 1969–1977

remaining_gates: No inference that practice is common today or spiritually effective as payment.
